title: Casdoor provider template (provider.json)
description: Fields are named as in Casdoor's Provider object; the installer copies them into a new provider after replacing {{variables}}. The client ID and secret the other identity provider issued are not part of the template: the installer asks for them ({{clientId}} and {{clientSecret}} in guide text).

type.description: OIDC reads the endpoints from the issuer; Custom is plain OAuth 2.0 with a userinfo endpoint.

domain.description: OIDC only: the issuer URL, exactly as the iss claim of the ID token.

userMapping.description: Claim (dot path for nested values) for each user field. Fields left out fall back to the standard OIDC claims: id to sub, username to preferred_username, displayName to name, email to email, emailVerified to email_verified, phone to phone_number, avatarUrl to picture.

allOf.description: Casdoor's sign-in page builds the authorization request from customAuthUrl for both types, so it is always required.
